instruction: The final chapters are most relevant to my research. Please extract the last three chapters (6, 7, 8) as individual PDFs, using the naming format from chapter one.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting last 3 chapters (6,7,8) following the naming pattern. Verified by checking for main book + last 3 chapter PDFs (total 4 files). Chapter 6 has 13 pages, chapter 7 has 8 pages, chapter 8 has 14 pages.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary score: 1.0 if all expected PDF files are present with exact names, 0.0 otherwise.
